text: {"original_span": "Although the measured PGR is numerically far above the baseline, the uncertainty is substantial relative to that margin and only four seeds were run, so this should be read as a suggestive rather than an established effect.", "new_span": "The measured PGR exceeds the baseline by more than three standard errors, so the improvement is statistically reliable even with only four seeds.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "The 0.64 margin over baseline is about 3.4 SE only if SE were much smaller; with pgr_se = 0.19 the gap is ~3.4 SE but the original text and seed count make a reliability claim unsupported\u2014actually the span overstates certainty by discarding the stated caveat about substantial uncertainty and few seeds."}
